name: dsh-plugin-selfcheck
description: Terminal-first self-check for a DeepSeek Harness install: at boot it prints every plugin row in the loader tree (mounted / disabled / failed, with the exception text), then reports dependency version drift, profile config validity, web port reachability, and the registered tool inventory. Reads whatever plugins the user has; nothing is hard-coded. No client half, no web console, no background service.

scripts.test: node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/roster.mjs && node tests/checks.mjs && node tests/host-resolution.mjs
